cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stiegltiz, New York, NY); Maurice and Alma Morganthau Wertheim, New York, NY, 1925; Private collection, New York, NY, gift, before 1978; Private collection, Washington, DC, gift, before 1978; (Grace Borgenicht Gallery, New York, NY, and Hirschl & Adler Galleries, Inc., New York, NY), 1978; Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, and Elaine Horwitch Gallery, Scottsdale, Arizona, 1978; Private collection, Sun Valley, Idaho, 1979; (John Berggruen Gallery, San Francisco, California) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Sold to Maurice Wertheim. Note: Agnes Mongan saw this at Wertheim's house, Jan. 1946." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A large tree stands in the foreground, its dark silhouette contrasting with the glowing sky behind it. The sky transitions from a deep blue at the top to shades of pink near the horizon, where distant mountain peaks can be seen.
title: The Chestnut Grey
